question: Se qualcuno volesse fare oggi questo brick MEGLIO di noi, cosa aggiungerebbe?

competitors_known.name: LiteLLM
competitors_known.strength: 100+ provider, Python ecosystem, gateway proxy mode
competitors_known.weakness: Python-only, no Deno-native, no edge-function deploy, no task-type semantic routing (solo model dispatch)

competitors_known.name: OpenRouter
competitors_known.weakness: Aggiunge 5-10% margine sopra prezzo base, latenza extra +50ms, no logica task-aware nostra

competitors_known.name: Portkey
competitors_known.strength: AI gateway con load balancing + caching
competitors_known.weakness: SaaS proprietario, no JSR-native, lock-in piattaforma

what_competitor_would_add: Quality-aware routing (eval automatica con LLM-as-judge per task)
Adaptive routing (RL feedback: se utente rifa la domanda -> downvote)
Smart caching (semantic cache + KV per query identiche/simili)
Multi-region failover (Mistral FR -> Mistral La Plateforme EU -> Mistral OVHcloud BE)
Token counting client-side prima della call (evita overage)
Budget caps per tenant integrati nativi (oggi delegato a cost-meter-per-model)
what_we_already_do_better: Edge-function ready (Supabase, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers)
Task-type semantic routing (non solo model dispatch)
EU residency flag dichiarativo per clienti sovereign
Fallback chain automatica per ogni task type
Zero lock-in: ogni provider chiamato via API ufficiale diretta
Override force_provider+force_model per A/B testing controllato
roadmap_v0_3_0: Latency-aware re-ranking (warm cache di p50 per route)
speed_to_include: Q3 2026 streaming + semantic cache; Q4 2026 self-host adapter.
